summary_en: ProjectHoldings will acquire and cancel 137,043 treasury shares without compensation following the termination of its Board Benefit Trust (BBT) performance-linked equity compensation plan, in connection with the planned delisting resulting from TX1 Corporation's tender offer.
title_en: Announcement regarding termination of Stock Grant Trust (BBT) and cancellation policy for treasury shares
translation_en_brief: ProjectHoldings announced on November 19, 2026, that it will terminate its Board Benefit Trust (BBT), a performance-linked equity compensation scheme introduced in December 2024, and acquire without compensation 137,043 treasury shares held as residual assets of the trust. The company intends to cancel these acquired shares. The decision follows the delisting expected to occur through a series of squeeze-out procedures following TX1 Corporation's successful tender offer for ProjectHoldings' ordinary shares and subscription rights, as announced on November 12, 2026. The BBT was established as a trust arrangement with Mizuho Trust Bank as trustee and had served as a performance-based remuneration vehicle for the company's directors and executive officers (excluding outside directors) and eligible officers of group companies. No specific share price is disclosed as the acquisition occurs without monetary consideration under the trust agreement's termination provisions.
